articles.title: Bitcoin hits block 961,632 as the controversial BIP-110 soft fork attempt begins
articles.snippet: The proposal has scant support from bitcoin miners and influential commentators have also voiced their opposition.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
articles.snippet: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

articles.title: BitMEX sale collapsed as buyers balked at founder ownership and shrinking business
articles.snippet: Potential buyers, including Exodus, passed on BitMEX amid concerns over founder ownership and its shrinking business, according to a source familiar.

articles.title: US Senate to vote on advancing CLARITY Act in September after Thune files cloture
articles.snippet: The procedural move puts crypto market structure legislation back on track as lawmakers continue negotiations over ethics and stablecoin provisions.

articles.title: Bitcoin Payment Service BTCPay Warns Critical Flaw Is Under Active Attack
articles.snippet: Bitcoin company BTCPay Server told users to install the latest version of the server and replace credentials that may have been exposed.
